prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a hit while turning left. The patient had 28 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1371; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a collision sustained while turning left, with a resulting wrist fracture. The mechanism of the impact is consistent with the injury sustained, and the pattern of force described fits the fracture seen on imaging. Over the course of care the patient attended 28 visits, which is a somewhat longer course than is typical for an uncomplicated fracture of this type, though progress was documented at each stage of rehabilitation. Examination findings are partly supportive of the injury, with localized tenderness, reduced grip strength, and limited range of motion at the wrist, while several other tests returned within normal limits. No prior injury to the same area has been reported or identified in the available history. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services. Ongoing monitoring and home exercise instruction have been provided, and the patient has been advised to return if symptoms worsen.
